summary: Frontend-only testing of iteration 8 changes: (1) sendGmail mobile-vs-desktop routing, (2) new StatsPanel component + day-grouped notes list, (3) Export OLO / Export JSON / Reset mese buttons — on BOTH the fullstack React app and the /standalone.html. All new features work correctly. FULLSTACK: after admin login + PDF upload of /tmp/sample.pdf: stats-panel shows Totale=4, Oggi=4 (emerald rgb(5,150,105)), Media giornaliera=4.0 (emerald), Questo mese=4 (media 4.0/g); Ultimi giorni bar 'Gio 10/09' green with count 4; notes-groups contains data-testid='day-group-2026-09-10' with all 4 note cards. Export OLO downloaded 'codici-olo-2026-09-10.txt' with WN_9002456773, EDE_00000000062594, COC_90000000431280, FW_P00000035405 (one per line). Export JSON downloaded 'note-openfiber-2026-09-10.json' with {exported_at, total:4, notes:[4 objects]}. Reset mese (confirm dialog accepted) triggered toast 'Reset completato: 4 note eliminate' and stats went to zero. Desktop Gmail (default UA): captured anchor.href = 'https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&tf=1&to=...' containing all 5 recipients (g.c.impiantiufficio, g.c.impiantisnc4, giuseppe.abbatiscianni, dario.naviglio, vito.lalario) and subject WR:<wr>. Mobile UA (Android via context.add_init_script overriding navigator.userAgent, canShare()=>false): navigator.userAgent successfully reports Android UA at page eval time, so the isMobile branch runs; however direct capture of the `window.location.href = mailto:...` assignment via Object.defineProperty on Location.prototype/instance FAILED because Chromium marks `location` as non-configurable — 3 different interception techniques tried (instance defineProperty, prototype defineProperty, Proxy wrap) all rejected by the browser. Nevertheless the source code at App.js:524-528 unambiguously executes `window.location.href = mailto:${to}?subject=WR%3A%20${wr}&body=${noteText}` when isMobile is true and (canShare returns false OR no files), and the UA override was confirmed active; no mail.google.com anchor was created in this branch (verified 0 anchors with mail.google.com href after mobile click). STANDALONE (/standalone.html): #statsPanel visible after PDF upload; #notesList shows day header 'Gio 10/09' + '4 note' count; Export JSON download 'note-openfiber-2026-09-10.json' works; Export OLO download 'codici-olo-2026-09-10.txt' works; Reset mese hides #statsPanel (visible=false) and shows 'Reset completato' toast. All data-testid selectors present as documented. No console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: sendGmail mailto path uses `window.location.href = mailto:...` which is fine on real mobile devices but is impossible to unit-test with Playwright because Chromium disallows redefining `location` (non-configurable) and does not fire request/framenavigated for mailto: schemes. If future test coverage of this path is required, consider dispatching via a wrapper like `window.__openMailto(url)` that can be spied on during tests, or use a CDP setUserAgent + Network.setInterception. Not a functional bug.

StatsPanel Reset mese behavior differs slightly between fullstack and standalone: standalone hides #statsPanel completely after reset (nice), while the React fullstack keeps the panel mounted showing zeros (still fine and per the request 'panel hides OR shows 0'). Consider unifying UX.

Export OLO writes duplicates if the same PDF is uploaded multiple times (each upload creates 4 more notes for the same 4 WRs). This is pre-existing DB behavior unrelated to this iteration; the export code correctly maps notes -> OLO one-per-line.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for verifiable paths; 1 path (mobile mailto navigation capture) not directly assertable in Chromium/Playwright but source-verified and UA branch confirmed active

seed_data_creation: None — used existing admin (giuseppe97belviso@gmail.com / Mucchetta4!) and /tmp/sample.pdf. Cleaned up via Reset mese after each test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To programmatically verify mailto navigation in future iterations, ask main agent to wrap `window.location.href = mailto` in a small helper (e.g., `openMailto(url)` on window) that can be spied. Otherwise verify by checking the UI toast 'Apertura Gmail…' which is shown after mailto assignment. All new data-testid attributes documented in the request are present and functional: stats-panel, stat-total, stat-today, stat-daily-avg, stat-month, export-olo-btn, export-all-btn, reset-month-btn, notes-groups, day-group-<YYYY-MM-DD>. Standalone uses id-selectors (#statsPanel, #btnExportOlo, #btnExportAll, #btnResetMonth) which also carry matching data-testid attributes.
